snippet.title: MECHBORN - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing MECHBORN, an upcoming roguelike deckbuilder that blends Greek mythology with '90s-era mech anime. The hook is that your mech is your deck, meaning you can swap out parts as desired using your cards. Your job is to protect Earth from Kaiju attacks as one of 12 mech pilots with unique skills and backgrounds. MECHBORN will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2 in late 2026. Play the pre-alpha demo now on itch.io: https://turtle-juice.itch.io/mechborn
